CustomField.description: Skill versioning: this skill's content version, 1, 2, 3… Set only by ChatbotInstructionTrigger (ChatbotInstructionVersioning): a new record starts at 1, and the number rises by one only when Instruction_Text__c or Bundle_Fingerprint__c really changes (line endings and trailing spaces don't count). Re-ordering, descriptions, Usage, Active and positions never change it, and a value sent by an API call, Data Loader or a rollback file is ignored, so the number never goes down. Read by the LiteLLM proxy (skills line, Router_Decision__c versions list) and shown in CFO Bot's Library and skill cards.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. Rises by one whenever the instructions or the packaged bundle change.
CustomField.label: Version Number
